links.outcome: Malignancy detection rate of nurse-led screening with versus without AI decision support
links.effect: 25.5 vs 15.7 malignancies per 1,000 lesions; adjusted OR 1.73 (95% CI 1.68–1.77), consistent across nurse-experience tiers and subtypes; associational, non-randomised.
links.quote: AI-assisted screening was associated with a higher malignancy detection rate than standard screening (25.5 vs 15.7 malignancies per 1,000 lesions; odds ratio adjusted for nurse experience 1.73, 95% CI 1.68–1.77), a finding consistent across all nurse-experience tiers and the three major malignant subtypes.
